name: mathalama-focus-extension
description: Browser extension for Mathalama Focus Mode

scripts.build: npm run bundle && npm run copy-assets
scripts.bundle: esbuild src/popup/popup.ts --bundle --outdir=dist/popup --platform=browser --external:chrome && esbuild src/background/service-worker.ts --bundle --outdir=dist/background --platform=browser --external:chrome && esbuild src/content/content-script.ts --bundle --outdir=dist/content --platform=browser --external:chrome
scripts.copy-assets: cp manifest.json dist/ && cp src/popup/popup.html dist/ && mkdir -p dist/assets && cp assets/* dist/assets/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.dev: npm run copy-assets && esbuild src/popup/popup.ts src/background/service-worker.ts src/content/content-script.ts --bundle --outdir=dist --platform=browser --external:chrome --watch
